description: Supply the delivery address, which is what makes a total payable. Fold delivers only to the 50 states and DC. Sales tax depends on where the work is going and is recalculated on every call, so the total can change here. The work itself cannot be changed; start a new purchase instead. Until this succeeds, total_is_payable is false and the total must not be quoted as final. The response carries a new approval_reference: present THIS response to the buyer, and pass its approval_reference to confirm_purchase.

country.description: US: Fold delivers only within the United States. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

region.description: One of the 50 states or DC, as its two-letter USPS code, e.g. CO (its name, e.g. Colorado, is read too). Stored as the code. Territories and military addresses are refused.

name: set_delivery
title: Set the delivery address
